items.title: Bernie Kirsh interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 27, 2022
items.q: So I did that album and then started the “Leprechaun” in December of that year, ’75. Late ’75. And that was another major shift in influence and path of my life, going into that and working with Chick.

ctx.x: So then comes “Leprechaun” is that right?

Just after that is the “Leprechaun.” Now we’re talking from October to December. So I did that album and then started the “Leprechaun” in December of that year, ’75. Late ’75. And that was another major shift in influence and path of my life, going into that and working with Chick. And we hit it off really — I didn’t really get to know him much during the previous recording, I just did my job and that sort of thing. But now we were working together on a longer basis and I got to know him and we did this project…
Could you be more maybe specific about what he wanted to hear and what you heard also?
